recording.name: Credential Stuffing, as it is
recording.description: Run of an A/B comparison on helios-commerce with seed 42.

phases.name: Low and slow
phases.description: A trickle of login attempts tests which leaked credentials are still valid.

phases.name: Stuffing burst
phases.description: Login attempts surge past the identity service's capacity. Legitimate sign-ins start to fail.

phases.name: Adaptive rate limiting
phases.description: The gateway throttles login attempts per source, relieving the identity service.

phases.name: Source blocked
phases.description: The offending sources are blocked at the edge.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Attempts stop and authentication returns to normal.
